  358:       if (!id || seenPhysicalIds.has(id)) {
  359:         return [];
  360:       }
  361: 
  362:       seenPhysicalIds.add(id);
  363:       const sourcePageIds = uniqueStrings(
  364:         page.sourcePageIds.length
  365:           ? page.sourcePageIds
  366:           : corePage.sourcePageIds,
  367:       );
  368:       const sourceLogicalPageId = sourcePageIds[0] || "logical-page-1";
  369:       const physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage =
  370:         (logicalPageCounters.get(sourceLogicalPageId) || 0) + 1;
  371:       logicalPageCounters.set(
  372:         sourceLogicalPageId,
  373:         physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage,
  374:       );
  375:       const sourceTitle =
  376:         logicalTitles.get(sourceLogicalPageId) || corePage.title || "التقرير";
  377:       const title =
  378:         physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage === 1
  379:           ? sourceTitle
  380:           : `${sourceTitle} - صفحة ${physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage}`;
  381: 
  382:       return [{
  383:         ...page,
  384:         title,
  385:         sourcePageIds,
  386:         corePhysicalPageId: corePage.id,
  387:         physicalPageIndex: seenPhysicalIds.size - 1,
  388:         physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage,
  389:       }];
  390:     });
  391:   });
  392: }
  393: 
  394: function buildPhysicalNavigationItems(
  395:   pages: readonly PhysicalPage[],
  396: ): ReportTwoPhysicalNavigationItem[] {
  397:   return pages.map((page, index) => ({
  398:     physicalPageId: page.id,
  399:     corePhysicalPageId: page.corePhysicalPageId,
  400:     sourceLogicalPageId: page.sourcePageIds[0] || "logical-page-1",
  401:     sourcePageIds: [...page.sourcePageIds],
  402:     label: page.title,
  403:     physicalPageIndex: index,
  404:     physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage:
  405:       page.physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage || 1,
  406:     role: page.physicalPageRole,
  407:   }));
  408: }
  409: 
  410: export function SmartPhysicalReportComposer({
  411:   designId,
  412:   pages,
  413:   activePageId,
  414:   activePhysicalPageId,
  415:   context,
  416:   previewCase,
  417:   fallbackPageLabel = "التقرير",
  418:   renderMode = "stack",
  419:   suppressAutoEvidencePages = false,
  420:   onPhysicalPagesChange,
  421: }: SmartPhysicalReportComposerProps) {
  422:   const logicalPageModels = useMemo(
  423:     () => buildLogicalPageModels(pages || []),
  424:     [pages],
  425:   );
  426: 
  427:   const semanticInputFingerprint = useMemo(
  428:     () =>
  429:       buildSemanticInputFingerprint(
  430:         designId,
  431:         pages || [],
  432:         context,
  433:         previewCase,
  434:         fallbackPageLabel,
  435:         suppressAutoEvidencePages,
  436:       ),
  437:     [
  438:       context,
  439:       designId,
  440:       fallbackPageLabel,
  441:       pages,
  442:       previewCase,
  443:       suppressAutoEvidencePages,
  444:     ],
  445:   );
  446: 
  447:   const semanticFingerprintParts = useMemo(
  448:     () => ({
  449:       content: semanticInputFingerprint,
  450:       design: createSemanticInputFingerprint(designId),
  451:       evidence: createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  452:         blocks: pages.flatMap((page) =>
  453:           (page.blocks || []).filter(isEvidenceBlock),
  454:         ),
  455:         evidences: previewCase?.evidences || [],
  456:       }),
  457:       header: createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  458:         fallbackPageLabel,
  459:         settings: Object.fromEntries(
  460:           Object.entries(context).filter(([key]) =>
  461:             key.startsWith("identity.") ||
  462:             key.startsWith("report."),
  463:           ),
  464:         ),
  465:       }),
  466:       pageStructure: createSemanticInputFingerprint(
  467:         pages.map((page) => ({
  468:           blocks: (page.blocks || []).map((block) => ({
  469:             id: block?.id,
  470:             kind: block?.kind,
  471:             placement: block?.placement,
  472:           })),
  473:           id: page.id,
  474:           kind: page.kind,
  475:         })),
  476:       ),
  477:       signatures: createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  478:         blocks: pages.flatMap((page) =>
  479:           (page.blocks || []).filter(isSignatureBlock),
  480:         ),
  481:         context: Object.fromEntries(
  482:           Object.entries(context).filter(([key]) =>
  483:             key.toLowerCase().includes("signature"),
  484:           ),
  485:         ),
  486:       }),
  487:     }),
  488:     [
  489:       context,
  490:       designId,
  491:       fallbackPageLabel,
  492:       pages,
  493:       previewCase?.evidences,
  494:       semanticInputFingerprint,
  495:     ],
  496:   );
  497: 
  498:   const semanticFingerprintPartsFingerprint = useMemo(
  499:     () => createSemanticInputFingerprint(semanticFingerprintParts),
  500:     [semanticFingerprintParts],
  501:   );
  502: 
  503:   const measurementHostRef =
  504:     useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  505: 
  506:   const outputHostRef =
  507:     useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  508: 
  509:   const [physicalPages, setPhysicalPages] =
  510:     useState<PhysicalPage[]>([]);
  511: 
  512:   const [finalPhysicalPages, setFinalPhysicalPages] =
  513:     useState<PhysicalPage[]>([]);
  514: 
  515:   const [pageCompositions, setPageCompositions] =
  516:     useState<Record<string, ReportPhysicalPageComposition>>({});
  517: 
  518:   const [acceptedItems, setAcceptedItems] =
  519:     useState<FlowItem[]>([]);
  520: 
  521:   const [logicalPageIndex, setLogicalPageIndex] =
  522:     useState(0);
  523: 
  524:   const [currentLogicalPhysicalPages, setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages] =
  525:     useState<PhysicalPage[]>([]);
  526: 
  527:   const [cursor, setCursor] =
  528:     useState(0);
  529: 
  530:   const [candidateVersion, setCandidateVersion] =
  531:     useState(0);
  532: 
  533:   const [done, setDone] =
  534:     useState(false);
  535: 
  536:   const [planningPhase, setPlanningPhase] =
  537:     useState<PhysicalPlanningPhase>("DIRTY");
  538: 
  539:   const [plannedResetKey, setPlannedResetKey] =
  540:     useState(semanticInputFingerprint);
  541: 
  542:   const planningPhaseRef =
  543:     useRef<PhysicalPlanningPhase>("DIRTY");
  544: 
  545:   const outputStabilityRef = useRef({
  546:     signature: "",
  547:     count: 0,
  548:     attempts: 0,
  549:   });
  550: 
  551:   const finalizedPlanRef = useRef<{
  552:     semanticInputFingerprint: string;
  553:     layoutResultFingerprint: string;
  554:     pages: readonly PhysicalPage[];
  555:   } | null>(null);
  556: 
  557:   const previousSemanticPartsRef =
  558:     useRef<typeof semanticFingerprintParts | null>(null);
  559: 
  560:   const [invalidationReason, setInvalidationReason] =
  561:     useState<PhysicalInvalidationReason>("initial");
  562: 
  563:   const fontsSettledRef = useRef(false);
  564:   const settledAssetSourcesRef = useRef(new Set<string>());
  565:   const outputResizeFingerprintRef = useRef("");
  566: 
  567:   const decisionLockRef =
  568:     useRef(false);
  569: 
  570:   /*
  571:    * New report/template data => rebuild physical pagination.
  572:    */
  573:   useEffect(() => {
  574:     const currentParts = JSON.parse(
  575:       semanticFingerprintPartsFingerprint,
  576:     ) as typeof semanticFingerprintParts;
  577:     const previousParts = previousSemanticPartsRef.current;
  578: 
  579:     const nextInvalidationReason: PhysicalInvalidationReason = !previousParts
  580:       ? "initial"
  581:       : previousParts.design !== currentParts.design
  582:         ? "design-change"
  583:         : previousParts.pageStructure !==
  584:             currentParts.pageStructure
  585:           ? "page-structure-change"
  586:           : previousParts.evidence !== currentParts.evidence
  587:             ? "evidence-change"
  588:             : previousParts.signatures !==
  589:                 currentParts.signatures
  590:               ? "signature-change"
  591:               : previousParts.header !== currentParts.header
  592:                 ? "header-settings-change"
  593:                 : "content-change";
  594: 
  595:     setInvalidationReason(nextInvalidationReason);
  596: 
  597:     previousSemanticPartsRef.current = currentParts;
  598:     finalizedPlanRef.current = null;
  599:     decisionLockRef.current = false;
  600: 
  601:     planningPhaseRef.current = "DIRTY";
  602:     setPlanningPhase("DIRTY");
  603:     setPhysicalPages([]);
  604:     setFinalPhysicalPages([]);
  605:     setPageCompositions({});
  606:     setAcceptedItems([]);
  607:     setLogicalPageIndex(0);
  608:     setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages([]);
  609:     setCursor(0);
  610:     setCandidateVersion(
  611:       (current) => current + 1,
  612:     );
  613:     setDone(false);
  614:     planningPhaseRef.current = "PLANNING";
  615:     setPlanningPhase("PLANNING");
  616:     outputStabilityRef.current = {
  617:       signature: "",
  618:       count: 0,
  619:       attempts: 0,
  620:     };
  621:     settledAssetSourcesRef.current.clear();
  622:     outputResizeFingerprintRef.current = "";
  623:     setPlannedResetKey(semanticInputFingerprint);
  624:   }, [
  625:     semanticInputFingerprint,
  626:     semanticFingerprintPartsFingerprint,
  627:   ]);
  628: 
  629:   const activeLogicalPage =
  630:     logicalPageModels[logicalPageIndex] ?? logicalPageModels[0]!;
  631: 
  632:   const completeCurrentLogicalPage = useCallback(
  633:     (corePages: PhysicalPage[]) => {
  634:       if (!activeLogicalPage) {
  635:         setDone(true);
  636:         return;
  637:       }
  638: 
  639:       const logicalPhysicalPages = corePages.length > 0
  640:         ? corePages
  641:         : [
  642:             makePhysicalPage(
  643:               physicalPages.length,
  644:               activeLogicalPage,
  645:               [...activeLogicalPage.fixedBlocks],
  646:             ),
  647:           ];
  648: 
  649:       const completedLogicalPages =
  650:         appendLogicalPageSpecialBlocks(
  651:           logicalPhysicalPages,
  652:           activeLogicalPage,
  653:         );
  654: 
  655:       setPhysicalPages(
  656:         canonicalizePhysicalPages([
  657:           ...physicalPages,
  658:           ...completedLogicalPages,
  659:         ]),
  660:       );
  661:       setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages([]);
  662:       setAcceptedItems([]);
  663:       setCursor(0);
  664: 
  665:       if (logicalPageIndex >= logicalPageModels.length - 1) {
  666:         setDone(true);
  667:       } else {
  668:         setLogicalPageIndex((current) => current + 1);
  669:         setCandidateVersion((current) => current + 1);
  670:       }
  671:     },
  672:     [
  673:       activeLogicalPage,
  674:       logicalPageIndex,
  675:       logicalPageModels.length,
  676:       physicalPages,
  677:     ],
  678:   );
  679: 
  680:   const hasRegularItems =
  681:     activeLogicalPage.regularItems.length > 0;
  682: 
  683:   const nextItem =
  684:     activeLogicalPage.regularItems[cursor];
  685: 
  686:   const candidateItems = useMemo(() => {
  687:     if (done) {
  688:       return [];
  689:     }
  690: 
  691:     if (!hasRegularItems) {
  692:       return [];
  693:     }
  694: 
  695:     if (!nextItem) {
  696:       return acceptedItems;
  697:     }
  698: 
  699:     return [
  700:       ...acceptedItems,
  701:       nextItem,
  702:     ];
  703:   }, [
  704:     acceptedItems,
  705:     done,
  706:     hasRegularItems,
  707:     nextItem,
  708:   ]);
  709: 
  710:   const candidateBlocks = useMemo(() => {
  711:     if (!hasRegularItems) {
  712:       /*
  713:        * Signature-only report:
  714:        * signature is the core content because there are no
  715:        * regular blocks to pack.
  716:        */
  717:       const signatureBlocks = activeLogicalPage.signatureItems.map(
  718:         (item) => item.block,
  719:       );
  720: 
  721:       return [
  722:         ...signatureBlocks,
  723:         ...(currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0
  724:           ? activeLogicalPage.fixedBlocks
  725:           : []),
  726:       ];
  727:     }
  728: 
  729:     /*
  730:      * IMPORTANT:
  731:      *
  732:      * Physical pagination packs REGULAR CONTENT ONLY.
  733:      *
  734:      * Do not inject signature into the final regular candidate.
  735:      * Doing that caused this failure:
  736:      *
  737:      * fields                         -> fits
  738:      * fields + narrative + signature -> fails
  739:      * engine closes page at fields   -> WRONG
  740:      *
  741:      * Now:
  742:      *
  743:      * fields + narrative + other regular blocks
  744:      * are packed using the real Smart A4 measurement first.
  745:      *
  746:      * Evidence and signature are appended only after the core
  747:      * physical pages have been built, and SmartReportPageComposer
  748:      * negotiates their final placement.
  749:      */
  750:     return [
  751:       ...mergeAdjacentCommitteeItemsTableBlocks(
  752:         candidateItems.map((item) => item.block),
  753:       ),
  754:       ...(currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0
  755:         ? activeLogicalPage.fixedBlocks
  756:         : []),
  757:     ];
  758:   }, [
  759:     activeLogicalPage,
  760:     candidateItems,
  761:     currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length,
  762:     hasRegularItems,
  763:   ]);
  764: 
  765:   const candidatePage = useMemo(
  766:     () => ({
  767:       id:
  768:         `smart-measure-${candidateVersion}-${logicalPageIndex}-${cursor}-${acceptedItems.length}`,
  769: 
  770:       title: activeLogicalPage.sourcePageTitle || fallbackPageLabel,
  771: 
  772:       kind: "content",
  773: 
  774:       blocks: candidateBlocks,
  775:     }),
  776:     [
  777:       candidateVersion,
  778:       logicalPageIndex,
  779:       cursor,
  780:       acceptedItems.length,
  781:       fallbackPageLabel,
  782:       candidateBlocks,
  783:       activeLogicalPage.sourcePageTitle,
  784:     ],
  785:   );
  786: 
  787:   /*
  788:    * Special case:
  789:    * no regular blocks at all.
  790:    */
  791:   useEffect(() => {
  792:     if (
  793:       done ||
  794:       hasRegularItems
  795:     ) {
  796:       return;
  797:     }
  798: 
  799:     /*
  800:      * We still render the hidden measurement candidate first
  801:      * if signatures exist.
  802:      */
  803:     if (activeLogicalPage.signatureItems.length > 0) {
  804:       return;
  805:     }
  806: 
  807:     completeCurrentLogicalPage([]);
  808:   }, [
  809:     activeLogicalPage.signatureItems.length,
  810:     completeCurrentLogicalPage,
  811:     done,
  812:     hasRegularItems,
  813:   ]);
  814: 
  815:   /*
  816:    * DOM-driven physical page packing.
  817:    *
  818:    * Greedy but measured:
  819:    *
  820:    * current accepted blocks + next block
  821:    *              ↓
  822:    *     real A4 Smart engine
  823:    *              ↓
  824:    * fits? yes => accept block
  825:    * fits? no  => finalize previous physical page
  826:    */
  827:   useEffect(() => {
  828:     const host =
  829:       measurementHostRef.current;
  830: 
  831:     if (
  832:       !host ||
  833:       done
  834:     ) {
  835:       return;
  836:     }
  837: 
  838:     let frame: number | null = null;
  839: 
  840:     const inspect = () => {
  841:       if (frame !== null) {
  842:         window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  843:       }
  844: 
  845:       frame =
  846:         window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
  847:           frame = null;
  848: 
  849:           if (decisionLockRef.current) {
  850:             return;
  851:           }
  852: 
  853:           const viewport =
  854:             host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
  855:               ".report-smart-a4-content",
  856:             );
  857: 
  858:           if (!viewport) {
  859:             return;
  860:           }
  861: 
  862:           /*
  863:            * score=0 is the initial React state.
  864:            * Wait until the internal Smart A4 multi-plan engine
  865:            * has completed a real measurement.
  866:            */
  867:           const scoreValue =
  868:             Number(
  869:               viewport.getAttribute(
  870:                 "data-smart-a4-score",
  871:               ) || "0",
  872:             );
  873: 
  874:           const candidateId =
  875:             viewport.getAttribute(
  876:               "data-smart-a4-candidate",
  877:             );
  878: 
  879:           const smartA4Phase =
  880:             viewport.getAttribute(
  881:               "data-smart-a4-phase",
  882:             );
  883: 
  884:           if (
  885:             smartA4Phase !== "FROZEN" ||
  886:             !candidateId ||
  887:             !Number.isFinite(scoreValue) ||
  888:             scoreValue === 0
  889:           ) {
  890:             return;
  891:           }
  892: 
  893:           const minimumSafeSelected =
  894:             viewport.dataset.reportDensity === "minimum-safe";
  895:           const fits =
  896:             viewport.dataset.reportOverflow === "fit" &&
  897:             !(minimumSafeSelected && acceptedItems.length > 0);
  898: 
  899:           decisionLockRef.current = true;
  900: 
  901:           /*
  902:            * ---------------------------------------------------
  903:            * NO REGULAR CONTENT, SIGNATURE-ONLY CORE PAGE
  904:            * ---------------------------------------------------
  905:            */
  906:           if (!hasRegularItems) {
  907:             completeCurrentLogicalPage([]);
  908: 
  909:             decisionLockRef.current = false;
  910:             return;
  911:           }
  912: 
  913:           const isLastItem =
  914:             cursor >=
  915:             activeLogicalPage.regularItems.length - 1;
  916: 
  917:           /*
  918:            * Candidate fits:
  919:            * accept next block.
  920:            */
  921:           if (fits) {
  922:             const nextAccepted =
  923:               nextItem
  924:                 ? [
  925:                     ...acceptedItems,
  926:                     nextItem,
  927:                   ]
  928:                 : acceptedItems;
  929: 
  930:             if (isLastItem) {
  931:               /*
  932:                * Entire last REGULAR physical page fits.
  933:                *
  934:                * Evidence and signature placement happens only
  935:                * after the regular packing phase completes.
  936:                */
  937:               const basePage =
  938:                 makePhysicalPage(
  939:                   physicalPages.length + currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length,
  940:                   activeLogicalPage,
  941:                   nextAccepted.map(
  942:                     (item) => item.block,
  943:                   ),
  944:                 );
  945: 
  946:               const withFixed =
  947:                 addLogicalPageFixedBlocks(
  948:                   basePage,
  949:                   activeLogicalPage,
  950:                   currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0,
  951:                 );
  952: 
  953:               completeCurrentLogicalPage([
  954:                 ...currentLogicalPhysicalPages,
  955:                 withFixed,
  956:               ]);
  957: 
  958:               decisionLockRef.current = false;
  959:               return;
  960:             }
  961: 
  962:             setAcceptedItems(
  963:               nextAccepted,
  964:             );
  965: 
  966:             setCursor(
  967:               (current) =>
  968:                 current + 1,
  969:             );
  970: 
  971:             setCandidateVersion(
  972:               (current) =>
  973:                 current + 1,
  974:             );
  975: 
  976:             decisionLockRef.current = false;
  977:             return;
  978:           }
  979: 
  980:           /*
  981:            * Candidate does NOT fit.
  982:            *
  983:            * If we already had accepted content,
  984:            * finalize it and retry the same next item on a new page.
  985:            */
  986:           if (
  987:             acceptedItems.length > 0
  988:           ) {
  989:             const basePage =
  990:               makePhysicalPage(
  991:                 physicalPages.length + currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length,
  992:                 activeLogicalPage,
  993:                 acceptedItems.map(
  994:                   (item) => item.block,
  995:                 ),
  996:               );
  997: 
  998:             const finalized =
  999:               addLogicalPageFixedBlocks(
 1000:                 basePage,
 1001:                 activeLogicalPage,
 1002:                 currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0,
 1003:               );
 1004: 
 1005:             setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages((current) =>
 1006:               [...current, finalized],
 1007:             );
 1008: 
 1009:             setAcceptedItems([]);
 1010: 
 1011:             /*
 1012:              * Do NOT advance cursor.
 1013:              * Retry the overflowing block as the first block
 1014:              * of the next physical page.
 1015:              */
 1016:             setCandidateVersion(
 1017:               (current) =>
 1018:                 current + 1,
 1019:             );
 1020: 
 1021:             decisionLockRef.current = false;
 1022:             return;
 1023:           }
 1024: 
 1025:           /*
 1026:            * A single block itself does not fit.
 1027:            *
 1028:            * We cannot safely split arbitrary blocks here.
 1029:            * Preserve it intact on its own physical page and let
 1030:            * Smart A4 minimum-safe handle it without data loss.
 1031:            */
 1032:           if (nextItem) {
 1033:             const oversizedPage =
 1034:               makePhysicalPage(
 1035:                 physicalPages.length + currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length,
 1036:                 activeLogicalPage,
 1037:                 [nextItem.block],
 1038:               );
 1039: 
 1040:             const withFixed =
 1041:               addLogicalPageFixedBlocks(
 1042:                 oversizedPage,
 1043:                 activeLogicalPage,
 1044:                 currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0,
 1045:               );
 1046: 
 1047:             const newPages = [
 1048:               ...currentLogicalPhysicalPages,
 1049:               withFixed,
 1050:             ];
 1051: 
 1052:             if (isLastItem) {
 1053:               completeCurrentLogicalPage(newPages);
 1054:             } else {
 1055:               setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages(newPages);
 1056: 
 1057:               setCursor(
 1058:                 (current) =>
 1059:                   current + 1,
 1060:               );
 1061: 
 1062:               setCandidateVersion(
 1063:                 (current) =>
 1064:                   current + 1,
 1065:               );
 1066:             }
 1067: 
 1068:             decisionLockRef.current = false;
 1069:             return;
 1070:           }
 1071: 
 1072:           decisionLockRef.current = false;
 1073:         });
 1074:     };
 1075: 
 1076:     const observer =
 1077:       new MutationObserver(inspect);
 1078: 
 1079:     observer.observe(host, {
 1080:       subtree: true,
 1081:       childList: true,
 1082:       attributes: true,
 1083:       attributeFilter: [
 1084:         "data-smart-a4-phase",
 1085:       ],
 1086:     });
 1087: 
 1088:     inspect();
 1089: 
 1090:     return () => {
 1091:       observer.disconnect();
 1092: 
 1093:       if (frame !== null) {
 1094:         window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
 1095:       }
 1096:     };
 1097:   }, [
 1098:     activeLogicalPage,
 1099:     acceptedItems,
 1100:     candidateVersion,
 1101:     completeCurrentLogicalPage,
 1102:     currentLogicalPhysicalPages,
 1103:     cursor,
 1104:     done,
 1105:     hasRegularItems,
 1106:     nextItem,

components\report-engine\design-renderers\smart-layout\report-smart-table-pagination.ts

    1: import { paginateSmartReportTable } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-structured-table-extractor";
    2: import type { SmartReportTable } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";
    3: 
    4: const COMMITTEE_ITEMS_SOURCE_FIELD_KEY = "committee_items";
    5: 
    6: export type LogicalReportBlock = {
    7:   id?: string;
    8:   kind?: string;
    9:   title?: string;
   10:   sourceBlockId?: string;
   11:   sourceTableId?: string;
   12:   sourceFieldKey?: string;
   13:   visible?: boolean;
   14:   placement?: string;
   15:   settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
   16:   signatures?: unknown[];
   17:   evidenceStartIndex?: number;
   18:   columns?: unknown[];
   19:   columnWidths?: unknown[];
   20:   rows?: unknown[];
   21:   rowMetadata?: Array<{ gender?: string | null }>;
   22:   tableSettings?: Record<string, unknown>;
   23:   [key: string]: unknown;
   24: };
   25: 
   26: function text(value: unknown) {
   27:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
   28: }
   29: 
   30: function isCommitteeItemsTable(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
   31:   return (
   32:     text(block.sourceFieldKey).toLowerCase() ===
   33:     COMMITTEE_ITEMS_SOURCE_FIELD_KEY
   34:   );
   35: }
   36: 
   37: /**
   38:  * The estimated paginator keeps large tables row-safe. When two estimated
   39:  * committee chunks are candidates for the same measured A4, combine them so
   40:  * the real DOM measurement decides whether they fit as one continuous table.
   41:  */
   42: export function mergeAdjacentCommitteeItemsTableBlocks(
   43:   blocks: LogicalReportBlock[],
   44: ): LogicalReportBlock[] {
   45:   return blocks.reduce<LogicalReportBlock[]>((merged, block) => {
   46:     const previous = merged[merged.length - 1];
   47:     const sameCommitteeTable =
   48:       previous &&
   49:       isCommitteeItemsTable(previous) &&
   50:       isCommitteeItemsTable(block) &&
   51:       text(previous.sourceBlockId) !== "" &&
   52:       text(previous.sourceBlockId) === text(block.sourceBlockId);
   53: 
   54:     if (!sameCommitteeTable) {
   55:       merged.push(block);
   56:       return merged;
   57:     }
   58: 
   59:     merged[merged.length - 1] = {
   60:       ...previous,
   61:       rows: [
   62:         ...(Array.isArray(previous.rows) ? previous.rows : []),
   63:         ...(Array.isArray(block.rows) ? block.rows : []),
   64:       ],
   65:       rowMetadata: [
   66:         ...(Array.isArray(previous.rowMetadata) ? previous.rowMetadata : []),
   67:         ...(Array.isArray(block.rowMetadata) ? block.rowMetadata : []),
   68:       ],
   69:     };
   70: 
   71:     return merged;
   72:   }, []);
   73: }
   74: 
   75: /**
   76:  * Splits only table rows into generic continuation blocks. It never creates
   77:  * logical or physical pages; SmartPhysicalReportComposer still performs the
   78:  * real DOM-driven A4 packing for every resulting block.
   79:  */
   80: export function paginateStructuredTableBlock(
   81:   block: LogicalReportBlock,
   82: ): LogicalReportBlock[] {
   83:   if (block.kind !== "structured-table") {
   84:     return [block];
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   const columns = Array.isArray(block.columns)
   88:     ? block.columns.map((column) => text(column))
   89:     : [];
   90:   const rows = Array.isArray(block.rows) ? block.rows : [];
   91: 
   92:   if (!columns.length || !rows.length) {
   93:     return [block];
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   const sourceBlockId = text(block.sourceBlockId) || text(block.id) || "structured-table";
   97:   const settings = block.tableSettings || {};
   98:   const committeeItemsTable = isCommitteeItemsTable(block);
   99:   const table: SmartReportTable = {
  100:     id: text(block.sourceTableId) || sourceBlockId,
  101:     sourceFieldKey: text(block.sourceFieldKey),
  102:     title: text(block.title),
  103:     columns: columns.map((label, index) => ({
  104:       key: `column_${index}`,
  105:       label,
  106:       ...(Number(block.columnWidths?.[index]) > 0
  107:         ? { width: Number(block.columnWidths?.[index]) }
  108:         : {}),
  109:     })),
  110:     rows: rows.map((rawRow, rowIndex) => {
  111:       const row = Array.isArray(rawRow) ? rawRow : [];
  112: 
  113:       return {
  114:         id: `${sourceBlockId}-row-${rowIndex + 1}`,
  115:         cells: Object.fromEntries(
  116:           columns.map((_, columnIndex) => [
  117:             `column_${columnIndex}`,
  118:             text(row[columnIndex]),
  119:           ]),
  120:         ),
  121:         metadata: {
  122:           gender: block.rowMetadata?.[rowIndex]?.gender || null,
  123:         },
  124:       };
  125:     }),
  126:     settings: {
  127:       repeatHeader: settings.repeatHeader !== false,
  128:       compact: Boolean(settings.compact),
  129:       stripedRows: settings.stripedRows !== false,
  130:       highlightFirstColumn: Boolean(settings.highlightFirstColumn),
  131:     },
  132:   };
  133: 
  134:   const chunks = paginateSmartReportTable(table);
  135: 
  136:   return chunks.map((chunk, index) => ({
  137:     ...block,
  138:     id: index === 0 ? block.id : `${sourceBlockId}-table-part-${index + 1}`,
  139:     // A true committee continuation repeats the column header, not the
  140:     // report-section title or a visible "- تكملة" heading.
  141:     title: committeeItemsTable ? table.title : chunk.title,
  142:     showTitle:
  143:       committeeItemsTable && index > 0
  144:         ? false
  145:         : block.showTitle,
  146:     sourceBlockId,
  147:     rows: chunk.rows.map((row) =>
  148:       chunk.columns.map((column) => row.cells[column.key] || ""),
  149:     ),
  150:     rowMetadata: chunk.rows.map((row) => ({
  151:       gender: row.metadata?.gender || null,
  152:     })),
  153:   }));
  154: }

components\report-engine\design-renderers\smart-layout\report-smart-a4-measure.ts

    1: import {
    2:   REPORT_SMART_A4_FOOTER_BOUNDARY_GAP_MM,

    4:   type ReportSmartA4PriorityMode,

    8: export type ReportSmartA4BlockRole =
    9:   | "fields"
   10:   | "evidence"
   11:   | "narrative"
   12:   | "table"
   13:   | "signature"
   14:   | "title"
   15:   | "general";

   17: export type ReportSmartA4BlockMeasurement = {
   18:   role: ReportSmartA4BlockRole;
   19:   kind: string;
   20:   heightPx: number;
   21:   topPx: number;
   22:   bottomPx: number;
   23:   overflowPx: number;
   24: };

   26: export type ReportSmartA4Measurement = {
   27:   fits: boolean;
   28: 
   29:   viewportHeightPx: number;
   30:   contentHeightPx: number;
   31: 
   32:   overflowPx: number;
   33:

   38:   mainContentBudgetPx: number;
   39:   mainContentOverflowPx: number;

   41:   boundaryBottomPx: number;

   43: 
   44:   fieldHeightPx: number;
   45:   evidenceHeightPx: number;
   46:   narrativeHeightPx: number;
   47:   tableHeightPx: number;
   48: 
   49:   dominantRole: ReportSmartA4BlockRole;
   50: 
   51:   blocks: ReportSmartA4BlockMeasurement[];

   54: function round(value: number) {
   55:   return Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
   56: }
   57: 
   58: function getBlockRole(
   59:   element: HTMLElement,
   60: ): ReportSmartA4BlockRole {
   61:   if (
   62:     element.dataset.reportPriorityBlock === "signature" ||
   63:     element.hasAttribute("data-report-design-signature-block")
   64:   ) {
   65:     return "signature";
   66:   }
   67: 
   68:   const kind = String(
   69:     element.dataset.reportSmartBlock || "",
   70:   ).trim();
   71: 
   72:   switch (kind) {
   73:     case "dynamic-fields":
   74:     case "field-list":
   75:     case "case-meta":
   76:     case "student-summary":
   77:     case "service-summary":
   78:       return "fields";
   79: 
   80:     case "evidence-gallery":
   81:       return "evidence";
   82: 
   83:     case "multi-paragraph":
   84:     case "closing-note":
   85:       return "narrative";
   86: 
   87:     case "report-one-table":
   88:     case "structured-table":
   89:       return "table";
   90: 
   91:     case "hero-title":
   92:     case "meta-strip":
   93:       return "title";
   94: 
   95:     default:
   96:       return "general";
   97:   }
   98: }
   99: 
  100: function sumRoleHeight(
  101:   blocks: ReportSmartA4BlockMeasurement[],
  102:   role: ReportSmartA4BlockRole,
  103: ) {
  104:   return blocks
  105:     .filter((block) => block.role === role)
  106:     .reduce((sum, block) => sum + block.heightPx, 0);
  107: }
  108: 
  109: export function measureReportSmartA4Layout(
  110:   viewport: HTMLElement,
  111:   content: HTMLElement,
  112:   priorityMode: ReportSmartA4PriorityMode,
  113:   profile: ReportSmartA4Profile,
  114: ): ReportSmartA4Measurement {
  115:   const viewportRect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
  116:   const contentRect = content.getBoundingClientRect();
  117: 
  118:   const localScale =
  119:     viewport.clientHeight > 0
  120:       ? viewportRect.height / viewport.clientHeight
  121:       : 1;
  122: 
  123:   const safeScale =
  124:     Number.isFinite(localScale) && localScale > 0
  125:       ? localScale
  126:       : 1;
  127: 
  128:   const viewportHeightPx = viewport.clientHeight;
  129:   const footerSafeAreaMm = Math.max(
  130:     0,
  131:     Number(viewport.dataset.reportFooterSafeAreaMm || "0") || 0,
  132:   );
  133:   const footerSafeAreaPx = footerSafeAreaMm * (96 / 25.4);
  134:   const footerBoundaryGapPx =
  135:     REPORT_SMART_A4_FOOTER_BOUNDARY_GAP_MM * (96 / 25.4);
  136:   const physicalPage = viewport.closest<HTMLElement>(".pdf-report-page");
  137:   const pageFooter =
  138:     physicalPage?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-report-page-footer]") ||
  139:     null;
  140:   const fallbackBoundaryBottom =
  141:     viewportRect.bottom - footerSafeAreaPx * safeScale;
  142:   const realFooterBoundaryBottom = pageFooter
  143:     ? pageFooter.getBoundingClientRect().top - footerBoundaryGapPx * safeScale
  144:     : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  145:   const boundaryBottom = Math.min(
  146:     fallbackBoundaryBottom,
  147:     realFooterBoundaryBottom,
  148:   );
  149:   const footerBoundaryUsed = Boolean(pageFooter);
  150:   const usableViewportHeightPx = Math.max(
  151:     0,
  152:     Math.min(
  153:       viewportHeightPx,
  154:       (boundaryBottom - viewportRect.top) / safeScale,
  155:     ),
  156:   );
  157: 
  158:   const elements = Array.from(
  159:     content.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
  160:       '[data-report-smart-block], [data-report-priority-block="signature"], [data-report-design-signature-block]',
  161:     ),
  162:   );
  163: 
  164:   const blocks = elements.map(
  165:     (element): ReportSmartA4BlockMeasurement => {
  166:       const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  167: 
  168:       const topPx =
  169:         (rect.top - contentRect.top) / safeScale;
  170: 
  171:       const bottomPx =
  172:         (rect.bottom - contentRect.top) / safeScale;
  173: 
  174:       return {
  175:         role: getBlockRole(element),
  176:         kind: String(
  177:           element.dataset.reportSmartBlock || "",
  178:         ),
  179:         heightPx: round(rect.height / safeScale),
  180:         topPx: round(topPx),
  181:         bottomPx: round(bottomPx),
  182:         overflowPx: round(
  183:           Math.max(
  184:             0,
  185:             (rect.bottom - boundaryBottom) / safeScale,
  186:           ),
  187:         ),
  188:       };
  189:     },
  190:   );
  191:   const crossesHardBoundary = elements.some(
  192:     (element) => element.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > boundaryBottom,
  193:   );
  194: 
  195:   const signatureBlocks = blocks.filter(
  196:     (block) => block.role === "signature",
  197:   );
  198: 
  199:   const nonSignatureBlocks = blocks.filter(
  200:     (block) => block.role !== "signature",
  201:   );
  202: 
  203:   const signatureHeightPx = signatureBlocks.reduce(
  204:     (sum, block) => sum + block.heightPx,
  205:     0,
  206:   );
  207: 
  208:   const signatureReservedPx =
  209:     priorityMode === "signature" && signatureBlocks.length
  210:       ? signatureHeightPx + profile.signatureSafetyGapPx
  211:       : 0;
  212: 
  213:   const mainContentBudgetPx = Math.max(
  214:     0,
  215:     usableViewportHeightPx - signatureReservedPx,
  216:   );
  217: 
  218:   const mainContentBottomPx = nonSignatureBlocks.reduce(
  219:     (largest, block) =>
  220:       Math.max(largest, block.bottomPx),
  221:     0,
  222:   );
  223: 
  224:   const mainContentOverflowPx =
  225:     priorityMode === "signature"
  226:       ? Math.max(
  227:           0,
  228:           mainContentBottomPx - mainContentBudgetPx,
  229:         )
  230:       : 0;
  231: 
  232:   const blockOverflowPx = blocks.reduce(
  233:     (largest, block) =>
  234:       Math.max(largest, block.overflowPx),
  235:     0,
  236:   );
  237: 
  238:   const scrollOverflowPx = Math.max(
  239:     0,
  240:     content.scrollHeight - viewportHeightPx,
  241:   );
  242: 
  243:   const boundingOverflowPx = Math.max(
  244:     0,
  245:     (contentRect.bottom - viewportRect.bottom) / safeScale,
  246:   );
  247: 
  248:   const overflowPx = Math.max(
  249:     0,
  250:     blockOverflowPx,
  251:     scrollOverflowPx,
  252:     boundingOverflowPx,
  253:     mainContentOverflowPx,
  254:   );
  255: 
  256:   const roleHeights = {
  257:     fields: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "fields"),
  258:     evidence: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "evidence"),
  259:     narrative: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "narrative"),
  260:     table: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "table"),
  261:     signature: signatureHeightPx,
  262:     title: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "title"),
  263:     general: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "general"),
  264:   };
  265: 
  266:   const dominantRole = (
  267:     Object.entries(roleHeights) as Array<
  268:       [ReportSmartA4BlockRole, number]
  269:     >
  270:   ).reduce(
  271:     (best, current) =>
  272:       current[1] > best[1] ? current : best,
  273:     ["general", 0] as [
  274:       ReportSmartA4BlockRole,
  275:       number,
  276:     ],
  277:   )[0];
  278: 
  279:   return {
  280:     fits:
  281:       !crossesHardBoundary &&
  282:       blockOverflowPx <= 0 &&
  283:       overflowPx <= REPORT_SMART_A4_TOLERANCE_PX,
  284: 
  285:     viewportHeightPx: round(usableViewportHeightPx),
  286:     contentHeightPx: round(content.scrollHeight),
  287: 
  288:     overflowPx: round(overflowPx),
  289: 
  290:     signatureHeightPx: round(signatureHeightPx),
  291:     signatureReservedPx: round(signatureReservedPx),
  292: 
  293:     mainContentBottomPx: round(mainContentBottomPx),
  294:     mainContentBudgetPx: round(mainContentBudgetPx),
  295:     mainContentOverflowPx: round(mainContentOverflowPx),
  296: 
  297:     boundaryBottomPx: round(
  298:       (boundaryBottom - viewportRect.top) / safeScale,
  299:     ),
  300:     footerBoundaryUsed,
  301: 
  302:     fieldHeightPx: round(roleHeights.fields),
  303:     evidenceHeightPx: round(roleHeights.evidence),
  304:     narrativeHeightPx: round(roleHeights.narrative),
  305:     tableHeightPx: round(roleHeights.table),
  306: 
  307:     dominantRole,
  308: 
  309:     blocks,
  310:   };
  311: }

  122: function getModeReadabilityScore(
  123:   mode: ReportSmartA4Mode,

  127:       return 100;

  133:       return 69;

  143: function getFieldLayoutScore(
  144:   layout: ReportSmartA4FieldLayout,
  145: ) {
  146:   switch (layout) {
  147:     /*
  148:      * Preferred production layout:
  149:      * compact, formal and easy to scan.
  150:      */
  151:     case "packed":
  152:       return 8;
  153: 
  154:     /*
  155:      * Comfortable remains valid for very short reports.
  156:      */
  157:     case "comfortable":
  158:       return 10;
  159: 
  160:     /*
  161:      * Inline is a last-resort space saver.
  162:      * Do not select it merely because it saves a few pixels.
  163:      */
  164:     case "inline":
  165:       return -8;
  166: 
  167:     default:
  168:       return -20;
  169:   }
  170: }

  172: export function scoreReportSmartA4Candidate(
  173:   candidate: ReportSmartA4Candidate,
  174:   measurement: ReportSmartA4Measurement,
  175: ) {
  176:   const fitScore =
  177:     measurement.fits ? 1000 : 0;
  178: 
  179:   const readability =
  180:     getModeReadabilityScore(
  181:       candidate.mode,
  182:     );
  183: 
  184:   const fieldLayoutScore =
  185:     getFieldLayoutScore(
  186:       candidate.fieldLayout,
  187:     );
  188: 
  189:   /*
  190:    * إذا الخطة لا تدخل الصفحة نعاقب مقدار overflow.
  191:    * هذا يسمح باختيار أقرب خطة آمنة في حالة عدم نجاح أي خطة.
  192:    */
  193:   const overflowPenalty =
  194:     Math.min(
  195:       700,
  196:       measurement.overflowPx * 2.2,
  197:     );
  198: 
  199:   /*
  200:    * إذا الحقول تستهلك جزءًا كبيرًا من الصفحة،
  201:    * packed/inline يصبحان أكثر منطقية.
  202:    */
  203:   const fieldRatio =
  204:     measurement.fieldHeightPx /
  205:     Math.max(
  206:       1,
  207:       measurement.viewportHeightPx,
  208:     );
  209: 
  210:   const fieldEfficiencyBonus =
  211:     fieldRatio >= 0.28 &&
  212:     candidate.fieldLayout !==
  213:       "comfortable"
  214:       ? 5
  215:       : 0;
  216: 
  217:   return (
  218:     fitScore +
  219:     readability +
  220:     fieldLayoutScore +
  221:     fieldEfficiencyBonus -
  222:     overflowPenalty
  223:   );
  224: }
  225: 
  226: export function chooseReportSmartA4Plan(
  227:   evaluated:
  228:     ReportSmartA4EvaluatedCandidate[],
  229: ): ReportSmartA4Plan {
  230:   if (!evaluated.length) {
  231:     return {
  232:       candidateId:
  233:         "minimum-safe-inline",
  234: 
  235:       mode: "minimum-safe",
  236:       fieldLayout: "inline",
  237: 
  238:       fits: false,
  239:       score: 0,
  240: 
  241:       severity: "large",
  242:       dominantRole: "general",
  243: 
  244:       overflowPx: 0,
  245: 
  246:       preferEvidenceMove: false,
  247:     };
  248:   }
  249: 
  250:   const fitting =
  251:     evaluated.filter(
  252:       (item) =>
  253:         item.measurement.fits,
  254:     );
  255: 
  256:   const pool =
  257:     fitting.length
  258:       ? fitting
  259:       : evaluated;
  260: 
  261:   const selected = [...pool].sort(
  262:     (a, b) => b.score - a.score,
  263:   )[0];
  264: 
  265:   const measurement =
  266:     selected.measurement;
  267: 
  268:   const severity =
  269:     getReportSmartA4OverflowSeverity(
  270:       measurement.overflowPx,
  271:     );
  272: 
  273:   /*
  274:    * إذا التقرير لا يدخل إلا بعد dense/minimum-safe
  275:    * بينما يوجد شاهد في الصفحة، نفضل نقل الشاهد أولًا.
  276:    *
  277:    * هذا هو التغيير المهم:
  278:    * جودة النص والتوقيع أعلى أولوية من إبقاء كل الصور
  279:    * في الصفحة الرئيسية.
  280:    */
  281:   const aggressiveDensity =
  282:     selected.candidate.mode ===
  283:       "dense" ||
  284:     selected.candidate.mode ===
  285:       "minimum-safe";
  286: 
  287:   const hasEvidence =
  288:     measurement.evidenceHeightPx > 0;
  289: 
  290:   const preferEvidenceMove =
  291:     hasEvidence &&
  292:     (
  293:       !measurement.fits ||
  294:       aggressiveDensity
  295:     );
  296: 
  297:   return {
  298:     candidateId:
  299:       selected.candidate.id,
  300: 
  301:     mode:
  302:       selected.candidate.mode,
  303: 
  304:     fieldLayout:
  305:       selected.candidate
  306:         .fieldLayout,
  307: 
  308:     fits:
  309:       measurement.fits,
  310: 
  311:     score:
  312:       Math.round(
  313:         selected.score * 10,
  314:       ) / 10,
  315: 
  316:     severity,
  317: 
  318:     dominantRole:
  319:       measurement.dominantRole,
  320: 
  321:     overflowPx:
  322:       measurement.overflowPx,
  323: 
  324:     preferEvidenceMove,
  325:   };
  326: }

   51: 
   52: export function PageBlocks({
   53:   page,
   54:   context,
   55:   previewCase,
   56:   designId,
   57:   className,
   58: }: {
   59:   page?: any;
   60:   context: Record<string, string>;
   61:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null;
   62:   designId: ReportDesignId;
   63:   className: string;
   64: }) {
   65:   const blocks = (page?.blocks || []).filter((block: any) => block.visible !== false);
   66:   const flowBlocks = blocks.filter(
   67:     (block: any) =>
   68:       isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block) || (block.placement || "flow") === "flow",
   69:   );
   70:   const fixedBlocks = blocks.filter(
   71:     (block: any) =>
   72:       !isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block) && (block.placement || "flow") !== "flow",
   73:   );
   74: 
   75:   return (
   76:     <main className={`relative flex flex-col ${className}`}>
   77:       <div className="flex min-h-[inherit] flex-1 flex-col gap-[var(--report-block-gap,1rem)]">
   78:         {flowBlocks.flatMap((block: any) => [
   79:           isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block) ? (
   80:             <div
   81:               key={`${block.id}-bottom-reservation`}
   82:               aria-hidden="true"
   83:               className="min-h-0 flex-1"
   84:               data-report-signature-bottom-reservation
   85:             />
   86:           ) : null,
   87:           <div
   88:             key={block.id}
   89:             data-report-smart-block={block.kind || "content"}
   90:             data-report-smart-placement={block.placement || "flow"}
   91:             data-report-smart-movable={
   92:               block.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? "evidence" : "content"
   93:             }
   94:             data-report-priority-block={
   95:               isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block) ? "signature" : undefined
   96:             }
   97:             className={
   98:               isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block)
   99:                 ? "break-inside-avoid pt-[var(--report-signature-top-gap,1.5rem)]"
  100:                 : ""
  101:             }
  102:             style={
  103:               isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block)
  104:                 ? { breakInside: "avoid", pageBreakInside: "avoid" }
  105:                 : undefined
  106:             }
  107:           >
  108:             <DesignBlock block={block} context={context} previewCase={previewCase} designId={designId} />
  109:           </div>,
  110:         ])}
  111:       </div>
  112: 
  113:       <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
  114:         {fixedBlocks.map((block: any) => (
  115:           <div
  116:             key={block.id}
  117:             data-report-smart-block={block.kind || "fixed-content"}
  118:             data-report-smart-placement={block.placement || "flow"}
  119:             data-report-smart-fixed="true"
  120:             className={getPlacementClass(block.placement || "flow")}
  121:           >
  122:             <div className="pointer-events-auto">
  123:               <DesignBlock block={block} context={context} previewCase={previewCase} designId={designId} />
  124:             </div>
  125:           </div>
  126:         ))}
  127:       </div>
  128:     </main>
  129:   );
  130: }
  131: 
  132: 
  133: 
  134: function isDynamicFieldsDesignBlock(block: any) {
  135:   const kind = String(block?.kind || "").trim();
  136:   const smartKind = String(block?.settings?.smartBlockKind || "").trim();
  137:   const title = String(block?.title || "").trim();
  138: 
  139:   return (
  140:     kind === "dynamic-fields" ||
  141:     kind === "field-list" ||
  142:     kind === "case-meta" ||
  143:     kind === "student-summary" ||
  144:     kind === "service-summary" ||
  145:     smartKind === "dynamic-fields" ||
  146:     smartKind === "field-list" ||
  147:     title.includes("حقول") ||
  148:     title.includes("بيانات الحالة") ||
  149:     Array.isArray(block?.dynamicFields)
  150:   );
  151: }
  152: function getDynamicFieldCardsForBlock(block: any, previewCase: any) {
  153:   const configuredItems = Array.isArray(block?.dynamicFields)
  154:     ? block.dynamicFields
  155:     : [];
  156: 
  157:   if (configuredItems.length) {
  158:     return configuredItems
  159:       .map((item: any, index: number) => {
  160:         const id =
  161:           cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.id) ||
  162:           cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.key) ||
  163:           `dynamic-field-${index + 1}`;
  164:         const valueItems = Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
  165:           ? translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(item.valueItems)
  166:           : translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(item.value);
  167: 
  168:         return {
  169:           id,
  170:           key:
  171:             cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.key) ||
  172:             id,
  173:           label:
  174:             item.label !== undefined
  175:               ? cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.label)
  176:               : `حقل ${index + 1}`,
  177:           value:
  178:             item.value !== undefined
  179:               ? cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.value)
  180:               : "",
  181:           valueItems,
  182:           visible: item.visible !== false,
  183:         };
  184:       })
  185:       .filter((item: any) => item.visible && item.label)
  186:       .filter(
  187:         (item: any) =>
  188:           !previewCase?.hasStudentDataTable || !isStudentIdentityField(item),
  189:       );
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   return getWorkflowDynamicFieldCards(previewCase)
  193:     .map((item: any, index: number) => {
  194:       const id =
  195:         cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.key) ||
  196:         cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.label) ||
  197:         `workflow-field-${index + 1}`;
  198: 
  199:       return {
  200:         id,
  201:         key: id,
  202:         label: cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.label),
  203:         value: cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.value),
  204:         valueItems: Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
  205:           ? item.valueItems.map((valueItem: unknown) => cleanWorkflowDynamicText(valueItem)).filter(Boolean)
  206:           : [],
  207:         visible: true,
  208:       };
  209:     })
  210:     .filter((item: any) => item.visible && item.label && item.value)
  211:     .filter(
  212:       (item: any) =>
  213:         !previewCase?.hasStudentDataTable || !isStudentIdentityField(item),
  214:     );
  215: }
  216: function isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block: any) {
  217:   const kind = String(block?.kind || "").trim();
  218:   const smartKind = String(block?.settings?.smartBlockKind || "").trim();
  219:   const title = String(block?.title || "").trim();
  220: 
  221:   return (
  222:     kind === "signature-grid" ||
  223:     kind === "signatures" ||
  224:     kind === "approval-signatures" ||
  225:     smartKind === "signature-grid" ||
  226:     smartKind === "signatures" ||
  227:     title.includes("توقيع") ||
  228:     title.includes("اعتماد") ||
  229:     Array.isArray(block?.signatures)
  230:   );
  231: }
  232: 
  233: function getDesignSignatureCards(block: any) {
  234:   const signatures = Array.isArray(block?.signatures) ? block.signatures : [];
  235: 
  236:   return signatures
  237:     .map((signature: any, index: number) => ({
  238:       key: String(signature?.key || `signature-${index + 1}`),
  239:       label: String(signature?.label || "التوقيع"),
  240:       signerName: String(signature?.signerName || ""),
  241:       signerTitle: String(signature?.signerTitle || ""),
  242:       imageUrl: String(signature?.imageUrl || ""),
  243:       required: Boolean(signature?.required),
  244:     }))
  245:     .filter((signature: any) => signature.label || signature.signerName || signature.imageUrl);
  246: }
  247: function DesignBlock({
  248:   block,
  249:   context,
  250:   previewCase,
  251:   designId,
  252: }: {
  253:   block: any;
  254:   context: Record<string, string>;
  255:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null;
  256:   designId: ReportDesignId;
  257: }) {
  258:   if (block.hideWhenMissing && block.boundFieldKey) {
  259:     const value = String(context[`field.${block.boundFieldKey}`] || "").trim();
  260:     if (!value) return null;
  261:   }
  262: 
  263:   const rendered = renderText(block.content || "", context);
  264:   const textAlign = block.align === "center" ? "text-center" : "text-right";
  265:   const implementation = getReportDesignImplementation(designId);
  266:   const accent = implementation.palette;
  267:   const BlockRenderer = implementation.BlockRenderer;
  268: 
  269:   if (BlockRenderer) {
  270:     return (
  271:       <BlockRenderer
  272:         block={block}
  273:         renderedContent={rendered}
  274:         textAlign={textAlign}
  275:         context={context}
  276:         splitLines={splitLines}
  277:         splitParagraphs={splitParagraphs}
  278:       />
  279:     );
  280:   }
  281: 
  282:   if (block.kind === "hero-title") {
  283:     return (
  284:       <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, "hero", "text-center")}>
  285:         <p
  286:           className={["text-sm font-black", accent.subtleTextClass].join(" ")}
  287:           style={{
  288:             fontSize: "calc(0.875rem * var(--report-content-font-scale, 1))",
  289:             lineHeight: "var(--report-content-line-height, 1.75)",
  290:           }}
  291:         >
  292:           {context["service.name"]}
  293:         </p>
  294:         <h1
  295:           className="mx-auto max-w-[145mm] font-black text-slate-950"
  296:           style={{
  297:             marginTop: "var(--report-heading-gap, 0.75rem)",
  298:             fontSize: `calc(1.875rem * var(--report-content-font-scale, 1) * ${getReportFontSizeMultiplier(getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize"))})`,
  299:             lineHeight: "var(--report-heading-line-height, 1.65)",
  300:           }}
  301:         >
  302:           {rendered}
  303:         </h1>
  304:       </section>
  305:     );
  306:   }
  307: 
  308:   if (block.kind === "meta-strip") {
  309:     return (
  310:       <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, "soft", textAlign)}>
  311:         <div
  312:           className="grid md:grid-cols-2"
  313:           style={{
  314:             gap: "var(--report-value-grid-gap, 0.5rem)",
  315:           }}
  316:         >
  317:           {splitLines(rendered).map((line) => (
  318:             <div
  319:               key={line}
  320:               className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white text-sm font-bold text-slate-700"
  321:               style={{
  322:                 paddingInline: "calc(1rem * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  323:                 paddingBlock: "calc(0.75rem * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  324:               }}
  325:             >
  326:               {line}
  327:             </div>
  328:           ))}
  329:         </div>
  330:       </section>
  331:     );
  332:   }
  333: 
  334:   if (block.kind === "bullet-list") {
  335:     const customBulletList = implementation.renderBulletList?.({
  336:       block,
  337:       renderedContent: rendered,
  338:       textAlign,
  339:       context,
  340:       splitLines,
  341:       splitParagraphs,
  342:     });
  343: 
  344:     if (customBulletList !== undefined) return customBulletList;
  345: 
  346:     const contentFontSizeClass = getReportFontSizeClass(
  347:       getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"),
  348:       "text-sm",
  349:     );
  350: 
  351:     return (
  352:       <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, block.variant, textAlign)}>
  353:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  354:         <ul
  355:           style={{
  356:             display: "grid",
  357:             gap: "var(--report-bullet-gap, 0.5rem)",
  358:           }}
  359:         >
  360:           {splitLines(rendered).map((line) => (
  361:             <li
  362:               key={line}
  363:               className={["flex text-slate-700", contentFontSizeClass].join(" ")}
  364:               style={{
  365:                 gap: "var(--report-field-gap, 0.5rem)",
  366:                 lineHeight: "var(--report-bullet-line-height, 1.75)",
  367:                 fontSize: "calc(0.875rem * var(--report-bullet-font-scale, 1))",
  368:               }}
  369:             >
  370:               <span className={["mt-2 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", accent.dotClass].join(" ")} />
  371:               <span>{line}</span>
  372:             </li>
  373:           ))}
  374:         </ul>
  375:       </section>
  376:     );
  377:   }
  378:   if (block.kind === "multi-paragraph") {
  379:     const customNarrative = implementation.renderNarrative?.({
  380:       block,
  381:       renderedContent: rendered,
  382:       textAlign,
  383:       context,
  384:       splitLines,
  385:       splitParagraphs,
  386:     });
  387: 
  388:     if (customNarrative !== undefined) return customNarrative;
  389: 
  390:     return (
  391:       <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, block.variant, textAlign)}>
  392:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  393:         <div
  394:           style={{
  395:             display: "grid",
  396:             gap: "var(--report-paragraph-gap, 0.75rem)",
  397:           }}
  398:         >
  399:           {splitParagraphs(rendered).map((paragraph) => (
  400:             <p
  401:               key={paragraph}
  402:               className={["text-slate-700", getReportFontSizeClass(getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"), "text-base")].join(" ")}
  403:               style={{
  404:                 margin: 0,
  405:                 lineHeight: "var(--report-narrative-line-height, 2)",
  406:                 fontSize: `calc(1rem * var(--report-content-font-scale, 1) * ${getReportFontSizeMultiplier(getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"))})`,
  407:               }}
  408:             >
  409:               {paragraph}
  410:             </p>
  411:           ))}
  412:         </div>
  413:       </section>
  414:     );
  415:   }
  416:   if (block.kind === "report-one-table" || block.kind === "structured-table") {
  417:     const tableBlock = block.kind === "structured-table"
  418:       ? normalizeStructuredTableBlockPresentation(block)
  419:       : block;
  420:     const columns = tableBlock.kind === "structured-table"
  421:       ? (Array.isArray(tableBlock.columns) ? tableBlock.columns : [])
  422:       : Array.isArray(tableBlock.columns) && tableBlock.columns.length
  423:         ? tableBlock.columns
  424:         : ["المجال", "الإجراء", "ملاحظات"];
  425: 
  426:     const rows = tableBlock.kind === "structured-table"
  427:       ? (Array.isArray(tableBlock.rows) ? tableBlock.rows : [])
  428:       : Array.isArray(tableBlock.rows) && tableBlock.rows.length
  429:         ? tableBlock.rows
  430:         : [["", "", ""]];
  431: 
  432:     const tableSettings = tableBlock.tableSettings || {};
  433:     const compact = Boolean(tableSettings.compact);
  434:     const rounded = tableSettings.rounded !== false;
  435:     const highlightHeader = tableSettings.highlightHeader !== false;
  436:     const highlightFirstColumn = Boolean(tableSettings.highlightFirstColumn);
  437:     const stripedRows = Boolean(tableSettings.stripedRows);
  438:     const colorTheme = tableSettings.colorTheme || "light-gray";
  439:     const columnWidths = Array.isArray(tableBlock.columnWidths) ? tableBlock.columnWidths : [];
  440: 
  441:     const themeColors: Record<string, { border: string; headerBg: string; firstColBg: string; stripedBg: string; headerText: string; cellText: string; firstColText: string }> = {
  442:       "light-gray": { border: "border-slate-200", headerBg: "bg-slate-50", firstColBg: "bg-slate-50", stripedBg: "bg-slate-50/40", headerText: "text-slate-800", cellText: "text-slate-600", firstColText: "text-slate-900" },
  443:       "soft-blue": { border: "border-sky-200", headerBg: "bg-sky-50", firstColBg: "bg-sky-50", stripedBg: "bg-sky-50/40", headerText: "text-sky-900", cellText: "text-slate-700", firstColText: "text-sky-900" },
  444:       "green": { border: "border-emerald-200", headerBg: "bg-emerald-50", firstColBg: "bg-emerald-50", stripedBg: "bg-emerald-50/40", headerText: "text-emerald-900", cellText: "text-slate-700", firstColText: "text-emerald-900" },
  445:       "none": { border: "border-slate-200", headerBg: "bg-white", firstColBg: "bg-white", stripedBg: "bg-white", headerText: "text-slate-800", cellText: "text-slate-600", firstColText: "text-slate-900" },
  446:     };
  447:     const tc = themeColors[colorTheme] || themeColors["light-gray"];
  448:     return (
  449:       <section
  450:         dir="rtl"
  451:         data-report-structured-table={tableBlock.kind === "structured-table" ? tableBlock.sourceTableId || "true" : undefined}
  452:         className={
  453:           tableBlock.kind === "structured-table"
  454:             ? `mb-3 mt-5 break-inside-avoid ${textAlign}`
  455:             : getBlockShellClass(implementation, tableBlock.variant, textAlign)
  456:         }
  457:         style={{ breakInside: "avoid" }}
  458:       >
  459:         {tableBlock.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={tableBlock.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(tableBlock, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  460: 
  461:         <div className={rounded ? `overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border ${tc.border}` : `overflow-hidden border ${tc.border}`}>
  462:           <table className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-xs">
  463:             <thead
  464:               className={highlightHeader ? tc.headerBg : "bg-white"}
  465:               style={{ display: tableSettings.repeatHeader === false ? undefined : "table-header-group" }}
  466:             >
  467:               <tr>
  468:                 {columns.map((column: string, columnIndex: number) => (
  469:                   <th
  470:                     key={`${column}-${columnIndex}`}
  471:                     className={[
  472:                       `border ${tc.border} text-center font-black ${tc.headerText}`,
  473:                     ].join(" ")}
  474:                     style={{
  475:                       ...(Number(columnWidths[columnIndex]) > 0
  476:                         ? { width: `${Number(columnWidths[columnIndex])}%` }
  477:                         : {}),
  478:                       paddingInline: `calc(var(--report-table-padding-x, 0.75rem) * ${compact ? 0.78 : 1})`,
  479:                       paddingBlock: `calc(var(--report-table-header-padding-y, 0.75rem) * ${compact ? 0.72 : 1})`,
  480:                       fontSize: "calc(0.75rem * var(--report-table-font-scale, 1))",
  481:                       lineHeight: "calc(1.25rem * var(--report-narrative-density-scale, 1))",
  482:                     }}
  483:                   >
  484:                     {column}
  485:                   </th>
  486:                 ))}
  487:               </tr>
  488:             </thead>
  489: 
  490:             <tbody>
  491:               {rows.map((row: string[], rowIndex: number) => (
  492:                 <tr
  493:                   key={`row-${rowIndex}`}
  494:                   className={stripedRows && rowIndex % 2 === 1 ? tc.stripedBg : "bg-white"}
  495:                   style={{ breakInside: "avoid", pageBreakInside: "avoid" }}
  496:                 >
  497:                   {columns.map((_: string, columnIndex: number) => (
  498:                     <td
  499:                       key={`cell-${rowIndex}-${columnIndex}`}
  500:                       className={[
  501:                         `break-words whitespace-pre-wrap border ${tc.border} text-center font-bold ${tc.cellText}`,
  502:                         highlightFirstColumn && columnIndex === 0
  503:                           ? `${tc.firstColBg} font-black ${tc.firstColText}`
  504:                           : "",
  505:                       ].join(" ")}
  506:                       style={{
  507:                         paddingInline: `calc(var(--report-table-padding-x, 0.75rem) * ${compact ? 0.78 : 1})`,
  508:                         paddingBlock: `calc(var(--report-table-padding-y, 0.75rem) * ${compact ? 0.72 : 1})`,
  509:                         fontSize: "calc(0.75rem * var(--report-table-font-scale, 1))",
  510:                         lineHeight: "calc(1.5rem * var(--report-narrative-density-scale, 1))",
  511:                       }}
  512:                     >
  513:                       {String(row?.[columnIndex] || "—")}
  514:                     </td>
  515:                   ))}
  516:                 </tr>
  517:               ))}
  518:             </tbody>
  519:           </table>
  520:         </div>
  521:       </section>
  522:     );
  523:   }
  524:   if (isDynamicFieldsDesignBlock(block)) {
  525:     const dynamicFieldItems = getDynamicFieldCardsForBlock(block, previewCase);
  526: 
  527:     if (!dynamicFieldItems.length && previewCase?.hasStudentDataTable) {
  528:       return null;
  529:     }
  530: 
  531:     return (
  532:       <section
  533:         className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, block.variant, textAlign)}
  534:         data-report-dynamic-fields
  535:       >
  536:         {block.showTitle ? (
  537:           <BlockTitle title={block.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} />
  538:         ) : null}
  539: 
  540:         {dynamicFieldItems.length ? (
  541:           <DesignValueGrid
  542:             implementation={implementation}
  543:             block={block}
  544:             items={dynamicFieldItems.map(({ id, label, value, valueItems }: any) => ({
  545:               key: id,
  546:               label,
  547:               value: Array.isArray(valueItems) && valueItems.length ? valueItems : value,
  548:               valueItems,
  549:             }))}
  550:           />
  551:         ) : (
  552:           <p
  553:             className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 text-sm font-bold text-slate-500"
  554:             style={{
  555:               paddingInline: "calc(1rem * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  556:               paddingBlock: "calc(0.75rem * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  557:               fontSize: "calc(0.875rem * var(--report-field-value-scale, 1))",
  558:             }}
  559:           >
  560:             لا توجد حقول ظاهرة داخل هذا البلوك.
  561:           </p>
  562:         )}
  563:       </section>
  564:     );
  565:   }
  566:   if (block.kind === "field-list") {
  567:     const values = getFinalFieldListItems(block, previewCase);
  568: 
  569:     return (
  570:       <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, block.variant, textAlign)}>
  571:         {block.showTitle ? (
  572:           <BlockTitle title={block.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} />
  573:         ) : null}
  574: 
  575:         {values.length ? (
  576:           <DesignValueGrid
  577:             implementation={implementation}
  578:             block={block}
  579:             items={values.map((item: any) => ({
  580:               key: item.key || item.label || item.fieldKey || item.fieldLabel,
  581:                 label: item.label || item.fieldLabel || "تفصيل",
  582:               value: Array.isArray(item.valueItems) && item.valueItems.length
  583:                 ? item.valueItems
  584:                 : item.value || "غير متوفر",
  585:               valueItems: item.valueItems,
  586:             }))}
  587:           />
  588:         ) : (
  589:           <p
  590:             className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 text-sm font-bold text-slate-500"
  591:             style={{
  592:               paddingInline: "calc(1rem * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  593:               paddingBlock: "calc(0.75rem * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  594:               fontSize: "calc(0.875rem * var(--report-field-value-scale, 1))",
  595:             }}
  596:           >
  597:             لا توجد قيم مرتبطة بهذا البلوك.
  598:           </p>
  599:         )}
  600:       </section>
  601:     );
  602:   }
  603:   if (isSignatureGridDesignBlock(block)) {
  604:     const signatures = getDesignSignatureCards(block);
  605: 
  606:     if (!signatures.length) return null;
  607: 
  608:     const SignatureRenderer = implementation.SignatureRenderer;
  609:     if (SignatureRenderer) {
  610:       return (
  611:         <SignatureRenderer
  612:           block={block}
  613:           items={signatures}
  614:           renderTitle={() => block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title || "تواقيع الاعتماد"} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  615:         />
  616:       );
  617:     }
  618: 
  619:     return (
  620:       <section
  621:         data-report-design-signature-block
  622:         className="report-design-signature-grid-block break-inside-avoid"
  623:         style={{
  624:           breakInside: "avoid",
  625:           pageBreakInside: "avoid",
  626:         }}
  627:       >
  628:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title || "تواقيع الاعتماد"} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  629: 
  630:         <div
  631:           className={[
  632:             signatures.length === 2
  633:               ? "mx-auto grid w-[72%] max-w-[132mm] grid-cols-2 items-end gap-x-[8mm]"
  634:               : "flex w-full items-end gap-6",
  635:             signatures.length === 1
  636:               ? "justify-center"
  637:               : signatures.length >= 3
  638:                 ? "justify-between"
  639:                 : "",
  640:           ].join(" ")}
  641:         >
  642:           {signatures.map((signature: any) => (
  643:             <div
  644:               key={signature.key}
  645:               className={[
  646:                 "text-center",
  647:                 signatures.length >= 3
  648:                   ? "w-[31%]"
  649:                   : signatures.length === 2
  650:                     ? "min-w-0 w-full"
  651:                     : "w-[58mm]",
  652:               ].join(" ")}
  653:             >
  654:               <div
  655:                 className="report-design-signature-image-frame flex items-end justify-center rounded-md bg-white"
  656:                 style={{ height: "var(--report-signature-image-height, 10mm)" }}
  657:               >
  658:                 {signature.imageUrl ? (
  659:                   <img
  660:                     src={signature.imageUrl}
  661:                     alt={signature.label}
  662:                     className="report-design-signature-image max-w-[42mm] object-contain"
  663:                     style={{
  664:                       maxHeight: "var(--report-signature-image-height, 10mm)",
  665:                       background: "#ffffff",
  666:                       objectFit: "contain",
  667:                       mixBlendMode: "normal",
  668:                       filter: "none",
  669:                     }}
  670:                   />
  671:                 ) : (
  672:                   <div className="mb-1 w-full border-b border-dashed border-slate-400" />
  673:                 )}
  674:               </div>
  675: 
  676:               <div
  677:                 className="report-design-signature-name font-black text-slate-950"
  678:                 style={{
  679:                   marginTop: "var(--report-field-value-top-gap, 0.25rem)",
  680:                   fontSize: "12px",
  681:                   lineHeight: "1.25",
  682:                 }}
  683:               >
  684:                 {signature.signerName || "—"}
  685:               </div>
  686: 
  687:               {signature.signerTitle ? (
  688:                 <div
  689:                   className="report-design-signature-role font-bold text-slate-500"
  690:                   style={{
  691:                     marginTop: "var(--report-field-value-top-gap, 0.125rem)",
  692:                     fontSize: "10px",
  693:                     lineHeight: "1.25",
  694:                   }}
  695:                 >
  696:                   {signature.signerTitle}
  697:                 </div>
  698:               ) : null}
  699:             </div>
  700:           ))}
  701:         </div>
  702:       </section>
  703:     );
  704:   }
  705:   if (block.kind === "evidence-gallery") {
  706:     return <EvidenceBlock block={block} previewCase={previewCase} implementation={implementation} textAlign={textAlign} />;
  707:   }
  708: 
  709:   if (block.kind === "closing-note") {
  710:     return (
  711:       <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, block.variant, textAlign)}>
  712:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  713:         <p
  714:           className={["text-slate-700", getReportFontSizeClass(getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"), "text-base")].join(" ")}
  715:           style={{
  716:             margin: 0,
  717:             fontSize: `calc(1rem * var(--report-content-font-scale, 1) * ${getReportFontSizeMultiplier(getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"))})`,
  718:             lineHeight: "var(--report-narrative-line-height, 2)",
  719:           }}
  720:         >
  721:           {rendered}
  722:         </p>
  723:       </section>
  724:     );
  725:   }
  726: 
  727:   return (
  728:     <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, block.variant, textAlign)}>
  729:       {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} fontSize={getBlockSetting(block, "titleFontSize")} /> : null}
  730:       <p
  731:         className={["whitespace-pre-line text-slate-700", getReportFontSizeClass(getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"), "text-lg")].join(" ")}
  732:         style={{
  733:           margin: 0,
  734:           fontSize: `calc(1.125rem * var(--report-content-font-scale, 1) * ${getReportFontSizeMultiplier(getBlockSetting(block, "contentFontSize"))})`,
  735:           lineHeight: "var(--report-narrative-line-height, 2)",
  736:         }}
  737:       >
  738:         {rendered}
  739:       </p>
  740:     </section>
  741:   );
  742: }
  743: 
  744: function DesignFieldValueBlock({
  745:   title,
  746:   showTitle,
  747:   variant,
  748:   textAlign,
  749:   designId,
  750:   items,
  751: }: {
  752:   title: string;
  753:   showTitle?: boolean;
  754:   variant: string;
  755:   textAlign: string;
  756:   designId: ReportDesignId;
  757:   items: Array<{
  758:     key?: string;
  759:     label: string;
  760:     value?: string | null;
  761:   }>;
  762: }) {
  763:   const visibleItems = items.filter((item) => String(item.value || "").trim());
  764:   const implementation = getReportDesignImplementation(designId);
  765: 
  766:   return (
  767:     <section className={getBlockShellClass(implementation, variant, textAlign)}>
  768:       {showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={title} /> : null}
  769: 
  770:       {visibleItems.length ? (
  771:         <DesignValueGrid implementation={implementation} items={visibleItems} />
  772:       ) : (
  773:         <p className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">
  774:           لا توجد قيم مرتبطة بهذا البلوك.
  775:         </p>
  776:       )}
  777:     </section>
  778:   );
  779: }
